Juice of V2 a lemon.

%  barspoonful sugar.

              Fish House Punch
(Note:   In the original recipe for the Fish
  House Punch, cider was used in place of
  champagne, and no water used.)
Juice of 4 dozen lemons.
1Y2 pounds granulated sugar.
1 pint Curasao.
1 pint Jamaica rum.
1 pint benedictine.
1 quart peach brandy.
4 quarts bourbon.
Put above ingredients in a jug (not sealed) for
  about 10 days.    Shake occasionally. Strain
  through cheesecloth and serve in punch bowl.
Add 1 quart champagne.
1 quart of sparkling water to about 3 quarts
  of the punch.
